title: Indexed carry two-cycles and coordinate flags: conditional κ = 5.22712890914e-5
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This composes anchored multi-split recursion, balanced coarse sums, exact retired/pending frame indexes, bounded carry two-cycles, PR74 node order, late-use output routing and coordinate flags into one frozen finite conditional witness:

**κ = 261356445457/5000000000000000 = 5.22712890914e-5**, with bit saving **408390793141/7812500000000000**.

The exact value is about **0.8494742% above the reported pinned #74 construction** (`3f78d8967c009153f2df5c6a6577b6ab1d37e2ca`) and **0.4583459% above the reported #82 value** (`3410b940aa26e5876202152dfa7c4f66451ee22c`), observed 2026-10-08. These are historical comparisons. Complete pinned #74 and #79 recursive child lists are strictly excluded at the new accepted bit saving; #81/#82 comparisons use their reported values only. No foreign producer replay or current-global-frontier claim is implied.

A subsequent #74 revision at `428b5c167686b42a83f1abf7003c6d17aec561ea` reports **κ = 5.278214423139e-5**, above this frozen witness. That later construction is outside this package and has not been replayed here.

The result retains the inherited ordered residual compiler, all-size recursion, finite scalar overhead, routing, prime selection, exact recovery, fixed-tape and analytic transfer interfaces. It does not assert an unconditional or fully formal multiplication theorem, global optimum, or measured practical speedup. This package is stacked on #79 and preserves its complete published construction source and finite evidence at `9a58e62cf9e8954a4dde3c9b1372d733c276a6d1`.

### Construction

Both axes use anchored point order, balanced coarse columns when `i+j<ng-1` and rows otherwise, PR74 node order with natural region execution, pending next-use scoring, future unit completion, and up to three single-exchange and three two-cycle passes. h23 uses recursive split vector `[4,1,1]`, baseline outgoing-use order and cyclic coordinate shift one. h25 uses `[1,4,1]`, descending future-use deadlines and the pinned PR74 coordinate permutation. Code 4 splits first and middle eligible pairs with an explicit strict-contraction guard.

| Quantity | This witness |
|---|---:|
| h23 auxiliary roles | 26,834 |
| h25 auxiliary roles | 35,348 |
| Width W | 132,466,108 |
| Total recursive rank | 76,166,165,200 |
| Rank deficit | 1,846,900 |
| Largest child / parent dimension | 529 / 575 |
| Bit wire bits / row coefficient | 27 / 843 |
| Single exchanges, h23 / h25 | 1,492 / 1,554 |
| Two-cycles, h23 / h25 | 103 / 119 |

The exact indexes preserve the prior candidate order and both pending-frame containment tests. Two-cycles preserve each affected output/carrier basis, future-use uniqueness and total cardinality; every accepted swap lowers a fixed integer heuristic score. Coordinate relabeling preserves the scalar map and physical role operations, while actual fixed-coordinate child profiles are freshly recomputed. All physical XORs, raises, copies, dirty inputs and cleanup remain charged.

## Validation

The portable engine and PR74 node/relabel extracts are byte-identical to the audited frozen R5 source. Both parent physical words and both coordinate-relabeled words regenerate byte-for-byte. Construction `88ca39571907343a49e97f328971ec7bcd26fbfd` has source freeze `c5b314b4acff73f8fcd31802db2609f848ef6fcc2b63740fd985c353d994a612`. The source/finite-input closure contains 580 pins, including the code, configurations, proof, tests, selected words, profiles and additive integration files.

- Full ordinary-input and arbitrary-dirty-basis replay in both orientations, actual literal frame reconstruction, fresh bounded-minor/CRT profiles with zero disagreements.
- Complete paid child-list reconstruction, two independent rational moment enclosures, next 10^-18 bit and κ grid rejection, all 47 strict inequalities and seven margins.
- 23 focused controls for physical mutations, omitted charges/centers, mass-preserving profile mutation, missing pins, configuration/provider restoration, optimized Python, stale bridge fields, and full coordinate round trips.
- Actual-source strategy audits: 2,250 basis completions and 34,141 literal XORs; 800 random plus five targeted single-exchange cases; 1,204 two-cycle cases; 23,572 retired-index mutations/11,799 ordered queries; 27,926 pending-index mutations/13,971 ordered queries, including actual frame raises and future-containment rejection.
- Independent final selection audit binds all selected/parent bytes, full physical replay, fresh exact CRT profiles, and all **7,569 complete paid pairings**, with every other pairing strictly excluded. This is optimal within that enumerated frozen portfolio only.

The focused gate passed in 87.835 seconds. Independent portable-package review cleared all 580 working/staged/committed pins, all 250 original #79 archive files, unchanged R5/PR74/PR78 source bytes, both regenerated words and the complete exact arithmetic. The final 23 controls passed after two proof terminology corrections and preservation-only whitespace changes. The complete expanded repository run passed all **13 verification groups, 586 tests in 84 isolated modules, and 20 patch checks**, with unchanged source freeze and a byte-clean tree (1815.025 seconds). All **42 construction CI checks passed**. Receipt-only follow-up `424ef44609eda377250b2985a5210cb336ade19e` records these results without changing the source freeze or numerical witness. All **42 final-head CI checks passed**; this PR is ready for review and mergeable. The new `indexed` group retains every inherited verification group, formal package and workflow.

```sh
make indexed-cycle-verify
make verify
```

See `research/indexed-cycle/PROOF.md` for algebra and inherited scope, `SOURCE.json` for exact inputs, and `certificates/indexed-cycle-validation.json` for the focused receipt. Arithmetic cutoffs are not full operational thresholds; inherited Lean checks do not formalize the complete multiplication theorem.
